text:
Nina Patel: Hey team — quick one. Customers are reporting missing traces for a subset of requests hitting the /embed endpoint. Any idea where to start looking for trace origination filters before the app?
Sam W.: Do we have an ingress filter that strips trace headers? I know the old LB had a rule.
Kevin L.: There was a weird nginx sidecar config we rolled in Jan that normalizes headers. Could be that.
Maya - infra: I can check LB rules and IAM ELB listener actions. Also, is this only 1 region?
Nina Patel: Appears to be us-west-2 only. App logs show request_id but no traceparent in our app's logs.
Sam W.: Quick checklist I use: 1) curl with traceparent to edge -> see if it reaches app 2) check ALB access logs for traceparent 3) check sidecar/nginx config for header_filter directives
Kevin L.: Example curl:
```
curl -v -H "traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01" https://myhost/embed -H "x-request-id: test-123"
```
Nina Patel: Ran that, ALB access logs show the header present at the ALB but nginx logs show no traceparent.
Maya - infra: Probable header rewrite in the nginx config. Kevin, can you grep the config for "proxy_set_header" or "more_set_headers"?
Kevin L.: on it. Also FYI, obs-bot alerted about a drop in sampled spans for service:embed-service around 03:20 UTC. Might line up.
obs-bot: [alert] embed-service sampled spans rate dropped by 55% (03:15-03:30 UTC). Link: https://obs.redwood.company/d/alerts/embed-sampling-drop
Sam W.: If the header is dropped before our SDK receives it, OpenTelemetry SDK will create new root spans and we lose correlation. That matches missing traceparent but present request_id.
Maya - infra: Found this in the sidecar config: `more_set_headers "traceparent: \"\"";` — someone blanked it out for a test and forgot to revert. Oops.
Nina Patel: Can we hotfix to remove that? Which envs affected?
Maya - infra: Only the us-west-2 canaries. I'll patch the canary sidecar to stop rewriting in 5 mins, then verify with curl test above.
Kevin L.: After the patch, also check our trace sampler dashboard and the jaeger link: https://traces.redwood.company/search?service=embed-service&from=now-1h to confirm spans return.
Sam W.: Also fine-tune the alert threshold — currently triggers at 30% drop which is noisy. Suggest bump to 50% and add a rule to only fire if request_id present but trace rate decreased.
Nina Patel: Agree. Sam, can you open a small PR for the alert tweak? Keep the old rule as a lower-severity pager?
Sam W.: Yep — will do a PR after we confirm the patch.
Maya - infra: Patch deployed to canary. Re-ran curl with traceparent and it's now visible in nginx access log and app logs.
Kevin L.: I can see new spans arriving in Jaeger for those request_ids. Sampling rate back to normal.
Nina Patel: Thanks! Can someone add a short note to the onboarding doc about not blanking headers in sidecars? Saved us a bunch of time.
Maya - infra: I'll add a checklist item in infra runbook and drop a link here when done: https://docs.internal/redwood/infra/sidecars#headers
obs-bot: [note] thread resolved by Maya - infra (patch applied).
